gyms.name: Bali MMA
gyms.notes: Bali's most established fight gym (est. 2014). ~6 Muay Thai/boxing classes daily (08:00 & 09:00 pads all levels, 10:30 advanced, sparring Wed/Sat, 16:00–19:30 evening block). Ring, MMA cage, AC grappling room, ice bath, sauna. ⭐ Top pick for a 30-day trip. 🔥 20% promo now: monthly 2.32M IDR (~$143). Scraped from balimma.com Sep 2026.

schedule.title: Muay Thai & Boxing — weekly schedule (scraped Sep 2026)
schedule.footnote: *Sparring runs 10:30–11:30. Pads classes are all levels; Advanced = fighters. Gym hours: Mon–Fri 06:00–22:00, Sat–Sun 07:00–18:00.

gyms.name: Soma Fight Club
gyms.notes: Premium boutique fight gym — Muay Thai, boxing, BJJ, wrestling. Higher price, high-quality trainers. Open-gym-only monthly is 2M IDR. Prices verified from somafightclub.com (Aug 2026).

gyms.name: Body Factory Bali
gyms.notes: Luxury wellness gym, not a dedicated Muay Thai gym — great for recovery days (pool, ice bath, sauna). Silver 4-week plan 2.49M IDR +15% tax/service. Sister brand bodyfactorystays.com offers accommodation. Verify MT classes before committing.

gyms.name: Sinergy MMA
gyms.notes: ⚠️ Prices unverified (community reports, ~1.2–1.5M/mo). Budget-friendly local/expat gym, Muay Thai + MMA. Often recommended in expat groups. DM on Instagram to confirm.

gyms.name: Uluwatu MMA
gyms.notes: ⚠️ Prices unverified (~1.5–2M/mo). The main dedicated fight gym on the Bukit — best pick if you're staying Uluwatu/Bingin/Padang Padang. Muay Thai, boxing, BJJ. Confirm it's open via Instagram.

gyms.name: Bali Fight Academy
gyms.notes: ⚠️ Prices unverified (~1.5–2M/mo). Mixed community reviews — decent for beginners, scheduling reported inconsistent. Verify current status before committing a month.

gyms.name: Baik Bali Muay Thai
gyms.notes: ⚠️ Prices unverified (~1.5–2M/mo). Small friendly community gym, Thai trainers reported, authentic MT at budget prices.

gyms.name: Warrior's Path Bali
gyms.notes: ⚠️ Prices unverified (~2–3M/mo retreat packages). Holistic jungle retreat: Muay Thai + yoga + meditation. Great for wellness vibe, not a high-volume fight camp.

gyms.name: Legacy Gym Bali
gyms.notes: ⚠️ Prices unverified (~2–2.5M/mo). Solid mid-tier gym in Pererenan: Muay Thai, boxing, S&C. Positive reviews from long-term expat trainees.

gyms.name: Studio X
gyms.notes: ⚠️ Prices unverified (~1.5–2.5M/mo). Boutique fitness studio with boxing/kickboxing cardio classes — may not offer traditional MT pad work. Verify before booking.

gyms.name: Atlas Muay Thai (Bali)
gyms.notes: ❓ Could not confirm this gym exists — atlasmuaythai.com is an Australian gym. May be Instagram-only or misidentified. Verify independently.

gyms.name: Canggu Muay Thai (villa/mobile PT)
gyms.notes: Not a gym — trainer comes to your villa with pads and gear. Contact for weekly/monthly package rates. Great 1-on-1 supplement to gym training.

gyms.name: Bali Muay Thai (villa/mobile PT)
gyms.notes: Not a gym — island-wide mobile trainer service (Canggu, Seminyak, Ubud, Uluwatu, Sanur…). Best option if you're staying somewhere without a nearby gym. Contact for rates.

gyms.name: Alpha Force Thai Boxing Club
gyms.notes: ⚠️ Prices via muaythaimap.com (Sep 2026) — confirm with gym. Local Denpasar gym. Morning 8–11 AM & evening 5–7 PM weekday sessions. One of the cheapest monthly rates on the island. 📍 Jalan Imam Bonjol, Pemecutan Klod, Denpasar.

gyms.name: Dee Muay Thai
gyms.notes: ⚠️ Prices via muaythaimap.com (Sep 2026) — confirm with gym. Kerobokan (Seminyak side). Cheapest drop-in found (90k). Weekday mornings 9 AM–12 PM. 📍 Jl. Pengubengan Kauh No.1D, Kerobokan.

gyms.name: FR Muay Thai Bali
gyms.notes: ⚠️ Prices via muaythaimap.com (Sep 2026) — confirm with gym. Sanur option — rare for the east side. Mornings 8–9:30 AM, evenings 7–8 PM. 📍 Gg. Merpati, Sanur Kaja, Denpasar Selatan.

gyms.name: Island Warrior Bali Renon
gyms.notes: ⚠️ Prices via muaythaimap.com (Sep 2026) — confirm with gym. Renon, Denpasar. Very affordable (900k/mo). Mornings 8–10 AM, evenings 6–8 PM. 📍 Jl. Merdeka No.10X, Renon, Denpasar.

gyms.name: Lima Fight Club
gyms.notes: ⚠️ Prices via muaythaimap.com (Sep 2026) — confirm with gym. Jimbaran — handy for the airport side of the Bukit. Mornings 7–10 AM, evenings 6–8 PM. 📍 Jl. Gigit Sari, Jimbaran.

gyms.name: Lions MMA Bali
gyms.notes: ⚠️ Prices via muaythaimap.com (Sep 2026) — confirm with gym. Pererenan/Canggu. Mid-priced MMA + Muay Thai. Mornings 8–11 AM, evenings 5–8 PM. 📍 Jl. Raya Pererenan Tanah Lot No.3, Pererenan.

gyms.name: Mejiro Gym Bali
gyms.notes: ⚠️ Prices via muaythaimap.com (Sep 2026) — confirm with gym. Denpasar branch of the famous Dutch kickboxing lineage. Mornings 8–10 AM, evenings 6–8 PM. 📍 Jl. Pakisaji, Sumerta Kelod, Denpasar.

gyms.name: THE BLOCK
gyms.notes: ⚠️ Prices via muaythaimap.com (Sep 2026) — confirm with gym. Pererenan/Canggu boutique fight gym. 2.2M/mo sits between budget gyms and Bali MMA. 📍 Jl. Belulang Yeh No.9, Pererenan.

gyms.name: Tiger Muay Thai Bali & MMA
gyms.notes: ⚠️ Prices via muaythaimap.com (Sep 2026) — confirm with gym. Ungasan (Bukit). Bali outpost bearing the famous Tiger name — priciest monthly on the island (4.5M). Mornings 7–9 AM, evenings 5–6:30 PM. 📍 Ungasan, South Kuta.

gyms.name: Ubud Muay Thai
gyms.notes: ⚠️ Prices via muaythaimap.com (Sep 2026) — confirm with gym. Dedicated Muay Thai gym in Ubud. Mornings 8–10 AM, evenings 5–6 PM. 📍 Jl. Nyuh Gading No.19, Mas, Ubud.

gyms.name: Ubud Warrior Fight Club
gyms.notes: ⚠️ Prices via muaythaimap.com (Sep 2026) — confirm with gym. Budget-friendly Ubud fight club. Mornings 8–11 AM, afternoons 4–6 PM. 📍 Jl. Made Lebah No.2, Peliatan, Ubud.

gyms.name: Zando Fight Camp
gyms.notes: ⚠️ Prices via muaythaimap.com (Sep 2026) — confirm with gym. Fight camp in Ungasan on the Bukit. Mornings 8–9 AM, evenings 5–7 PM. 📍 Ungasan, South Kuta.

gyms.name: Zealot Muaythai Bali
gyms.notes: ⚠️ Prices via muaythaimap.com (Sep 2026) — confirm with gym. Seseh/Munggu, just west of Canggu — quieter area, solid pricing. Mornings 8–10 AM, evenings 5–7 PM. 📍 Jl. Pantai Seseh, Munggu.
